title: Lemon chicken with zucchini and avocado
description: Golden pan-seared chicken and tender zucchini served with cool avocado and fresh lemon.
steps: Cut the chicken into bite-size pieces and slice the zucchini.
Heat the olive oil in a skillet and cook the chicken until browned and cooked through.
Add the zucchini and cook until tender, stirring occasionally.
Halve and slice the avocado, then serve it with the chicken and zucchini.
Squeeze the lemon over everything just before serving.
